description: Lists the saved audiences of this workspace, one page at a time: each one’s id, name, the WhatsApp number it was saved for, and who it names (contact tags and that number’s chat labels, any or all). A campaign’s audience is one of these. They are made and changed on the Campaigns page of the Cosend dashboard by an owner or an admin, who sees who is in each; this tool only reads them. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

name: list_audiences
title: List saved audiences for campaigns
